evidence.quote: my projection is for the COVID-19 contagion shock to be disinflationary, not inflationary, and the data we are seeing so far are consistent with this projection.
we expect to maintain the target range at this level until we are confident that the economy has weathered recent events and is on track to achieve our maximum-employment and price-stability goals.
they will continue in coming months at least at the current pace, which should sustain smooth market functioning
despite the improvements seen in the May jobs report, the unemployment rate, at 13.3 percent, remains historically high.
given the likely depth of this downturn, are at risk of falling below that range.
The Federal Reserve will continue to act forcefully, proactively, and aggressively as we deploy our toolkit
